privacy.en:
Effective October 6, 2026. PatchRelay 1.0 · Hailink Labs.

Local documents

Show documents, patch routes, line checks and history are stored locally. Hailink Labs does not collect or upload them. No account, advertising, third-party analytics SDK or automatic cloud sync is used.

Apple and Keychain

Apple processes purchases and restoration through StoreKit. Verified access and first free Show eligibility are stored in the device Keychain. Backups do not contain trusted purchase credentials. The app requests no camera, microphone, photos, contacts, location or tracking permission.

Exports and backups

You choose the recipient or storage provider for PDF, CSV and JSON backups. Those providers handle files under their own policies. iCloud Drive is user-selected file storage, not automatic PatchRelay synchronization. Backups contain readable Show data; protect them and review content before sharing.

Retention and deletion

Archive and Trash retain records. Recent valid local recovery versions support recovery from mistakes. You can delete Show data in Settings. Uninstalling, device loss or damage may lose data without an external backup. Restore Purchases restores access, not Show files.
privacy.zh-CN:
生效日期：2026年10月6日。PatchRelay 1.0 · Hailink Labs。

本地文档

Show、接线路由、核对和历史保存在本地，不收集或上传给 Hailink Labs。无账号、广告、第三方分析 SDK 或自动云同步。

Apple 与 Keychain

Apple 通过 StoreKit 处理购买和恢复购买。验证权益及首份免费 Show 资格保存在设备 Keychain，备份不含可信购买凭证。不请求相机、麦克风、照片、通讯录、位置或追踪权限。

导出和备份

PDF、CSV、JSON备份的接收方和存储位置由你选择，服务方按自身政策处理文件。iCloud Drive 是用户选择的文件存储，不是自动同步。备份包含可读取的 Show 数据，请妥善保存并在分享前检查内容。

保留与删除

归档和回收站保留记录，最近有效恢复版本可帮助恢复误操作。Settings 可删除 Show 数据。没有离机备份时，卸载、设备丢失或损坏可能丢失数据。Restore Purchases 恢复权益，不恢复 Show 文件。

support.en:
Actual baseline and checks

Create a Show, add Acts and stage boxes, edit routes or import UTF-8 CSV. Declare an unconnected stage or manually verify planned routes as the actual baseline. Compare the next Act, confirm actions and check every line. Changed routes invalidate affected checks; returning to an old route does not restore PASS. Resolving an issue returns it to pending. Exclusions need a reason.

Save and back up

Wait for successful saving. If saving fails, retain data, check storage and retry; do not uninstall or clear data. PDF and CSV are frozen version snapshots. Save a full backup to Files outside this device. Restore validates data and imports a self-contained new copy. Imported runs need a fresh stage check.

Lifetime

The first real Show is fully usable for free; the separate Demo does not use this allowance. More Shows require the US$19.99 one-time Lifetime purchase in the United States. No subscription or automatic charge. Existing documents, export, backups and restoration remain accessible. Restore Purchases restores verified access, not Show data.

Scope and safety

V1 supports 64 active inputs, 10 Acts per Show and 10 stage boxes. No automatic cloud sync or collaboration. PatchRelay records your confirmations; it does not detect wiring, control a console, authorize opening sound or guarantee electrical safety.

Getting help

Email Hailink Labs with the app version, action and exact error. Keep an external backup. Do not send private documents or full backups unless you intentionally choose to share them.
support.zh-CN:
实际基线和核对

创建 Show、添加 Act 和舞台箱，编辑路由或导入 UTF-8 CSV。声明未连接舞台或人工核对计划线路作为实际基线。比较下一场、确认动作并逐条声检。线路变化使相关检查失效，改回旧路由不恢复 PASS；解决问题回到待检，排除需要原因。

保存和备份

等待保存成功。失败时保留数据、检查空间并重试，不要卸载或清空数据。PDF、CSV 是冻结版本快照。将完整备份保存到设备之外的 Files。恢复先校验再导入自洽新副本，恢复的 Run 需要重新核对舞台。

Lifetime

首份真实 Show 完整免费，Demo 独立且不占名额。更多 Show 在美国一次性 US$19.99 解锁 Lifetime，无订阅或自动扣费。已有文档、导出、备份和恢复数据持续可用。Restore Purchases 恢复验证权益，不恢复 Show 数据。

范围和安全

V1 每份 Show 支持64路活动输入、10个 Act 和10个舞台箱，无自动云同步或协作。App 记录人工确认，不检测接线、不控制调音台、不授权开声、不保证电气安全。

获取帮助

请提供版本、操作和准确错误并保留离机备份。除非主动决定分享，不要发送私密文档或完整备份。
